purpose: Test a legal format-boundary refinement while retaining the original complete-test oracle. This changes string content and is not an equivalence transformation.

policy.construction: Append exactly U+2028 LINE SEPARATOR to one original closed string field value. Render the new Python literal with repr.
policy.retrieval: A complete field identifier occurs in the public issue. This retrieves a location; it does not establish its allowed string domain.
policy.ordering: retrieval_rank, source path, value start byte
policy.unchanged: The complete original source control and all candidate bytes outside one string literal: decorators, setup, calls, assertions and other values.
policy.role_scope: Module-level tests; stable call argument bindings; unique direct local values; single-parameter literal pytest parametrization. Unknown aliases, mutation, helper or oracle roles abstain.
policy.semantics: This changes string content. It is not an equivalence relation. JSON string legality does not establish field legality, parser validity or unchanged expectations.
policy.admission: Require a fresh whole-test review of the actual producer, consumer, data format, public field domain and every retained assertion. Enum, date and embedded-language restrictions can reject a candidate.
policy.alert: Require repeated source-controlled failure, exact complete Python AST transport and a separate full-test independent audit.
policy.development_scope: One development-domain family; no claim of unified novelty or generalization from these trials.

semantic_policy.ordering: source candidate ranks round robin over sorted trial names
semantic_policy.interrupted_dispatch: unknown with reserved cost; no retry
semantic_policy.unknown: not executed; not an invalid test judgment
